name: Goldburg Family Foundation Aspire Scholarship (UQ)
summary: Extra first-year scholarship in UQ's Aspire scheme for Queensland Commitment Scholarship recipients.
who: Domestic student commencing any UQ bachelor program in Semester 1, with no prior bachelor-level study.
Maximum points in the Financial Hardship category of QTAC's Educational Access Scheme.
how: Apply using the online form. One application covers all scholarships in the Aspire Scholarship scheme.
catches: Applications opened 17 August 2026 and close 26 February 2027.

source.label: UQ Scholarships: Goldburg Family Foundation Aspire Scholarship

evidence.claim: Must hold the Queensland Commitment Scholarship
evidence.quote: have been awarded The Queensland Commitment Scholarship
